General Information Authority The 2014 Quadrennial Defense Review (QDR) established innovation as a central line of effort in the national defense strategy of the United States. The decisive military advantage of the United States over its adversaries and peer competitors is steadily eroding. Consequently, under 10 U.S.C. 3458, Contracting Officers may acquire innovative commercial items, technologies, or services using a competitive procedure called a Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO). Under a CSO, the Department of Defense may competitiv

cle protection for years to come. Leverage Government Investment: Utilize provided TDPs to accelerate development and reduce risk. Become a Key Partner: Establish a strong relationship with the GVSC and the U.S. Army. We invite qualified organizations with expertise in hardware development, firmware integration, and MOSA principles to submit proposals for delivery of 10 VBK prototypes, with a follow-on option to deliver additional kits. See attachment 0001 and 0002 Suspense date for submittal under this AOI is 12/19/2025. Technical Point of Contact: Mr. Andrew Culkin; andrew.culkin.civ@army.mil and Chad Wilson chad.j.wilson1.civ@army.mil b. Signature Management Technologies. Seeking innovative commercial solutions to mitigate ground vehicle and marine vehicle signatures. The signatures being requested include thermal, acoustic, and radio frequency, but others will also be considered. The technologies may be applique or coatings. The suite of equipment on a CL flightline must be rapidly deployed to support sortie generation (missions to attack an enemy position and return to the CL or another base). The elements of support can include, but are not limited to, aircraft power, conditioned air, refueling, rearming, and diagnostic and recovery tasks. To maximize flexibility, it’s desirable for the equipment to be multi-fuel capable (if fuel is required) and energy efficient to reduce the risk to operations from contested fuel logistics and to limit fuel pre-positioning requirements. In addition, it’s desirable for the equipment to support force sustainment elements, including human performance, low maintenance, and the wellbeing of the user.
